servers.source: Paraphrased fixture of the Context7 MCP server's two tools. Replace with that server's live tools/list output before a published run.

tools.name: resolve-library-id
tools.description: Resolve a package or product name to a library id that get-library-docs accepts. Call this first unless the user gives a library id.

tools.name: get-library-docs
tools.description: Fetch up-to-date documentation for a library by its library id, optionally narrowed to a topic.

servers.source: Paraphrased fixture of the DeepWiki MCP server. Replace with that server's live tools/list output before a published run.

tools.name: read_wiki_structure
tools.description: List the documentation topics generated for a GitHub repository.

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: Ask a question about a GitHub repository and get an answer grounded in its generated documentation.
